opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead research and hiring email draft
opportunities.description: Search GitHub for a username, open the user profile, open their top pinned repo to note followers, stars and language, then write a lead email to hiring@example.com for a given role.
steps: On GitHub, click 'Search or jump to' and type the {username}, then press Enter
In the results sidebar, click the 'Users' filter
Click the matching {username} result to open the profile
Note the follower count and the latest post or highlight
Open the top pinned repo and note its star count and main language
Set Body = '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {top_repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {latest_post}.'
Click Send (in the recording the user clicked Discard each time)

instances.values: username=karpathy; role=ML Research Engineer; repo=nanoGPT (63.8k stars, Python); 226k followers; latest post=microgpt
username=gaearon; role=Staff Frontend Engineer; repo=react/react (251.0k stars, JavaScript); 94k followers
username=simonw; role=Developer Advocate; repo=llm (12.6k stars, Python); 17.3k followers

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person lookup plus Wayback Machine snapshot of the related site
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, open a 2014 Wayback Machine snapshot of their organization's website, and save a summary note with key facts and the archived headline.
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {person} and press Enter
Read the key facts (birth date and role)
Open the Wayback Machine and enter {org_site} (or replace the URL in the Wayback toolbar), then press Enter
Pick {year} on the timeline and click a capture date
In Notes, add a new note: '{person}: {facts}. {org_site} in {year}: {headline}.' and press Enter

instances.values: person=Satya Nadella; org_site=microsoft.com; year=2014; note saved
person=Jacinda Ardern; org_site=beehive.govt.nz (typed into the Wayback toolbar); archive reloads, no note seen
person=Tim Berners-Lee; archive page reloaded; incomplete
